subject: Backup chain-of-custody + restore latency proof — Aurora Financial SIG request
messages:
From: Lauren Park <security@aurorafinancial.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Aaron Holt <aaron.holt@aurorafinancial.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 17:02:00 -0400
Subject: Request: backup chain-of-custody & restore latency proof for SIG/BCP

Hi Hannah,

As part of our SIG and SOC2 ingestion for Aurora Financial, our compliance team has a few concrete asks related to business continuity and disaster recovery. Can you share the following artifacts for the last six months (Sept–Oct 2026 window is highest priority):

- Backup rotation manifest (file-level listing, who executed rotation, timestamps).
- Signed hash chain / signature proof for backup objects.
- Sample restore traces showing wall-clock RTO for: (a) full primary DB restore from cold storage, (b) warm-cache (KV) restore + readiness for traffic.
- Any runbook excerpts that describe the manual steps required for a failover and owner rosters.

We'd like to review artifacts and then schedule a 60-minute witness run (screen share) the week of Nov 1–5 if possible. If you can provide an initial packet by Oct 31 that would be ideal. Please also indicate whether you can demonstrate a restore from a cold snapshot plus a warm cache replay during the same session.

Thanks,
Lauren Park
Security Program Manager
Aurora Financial

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Park <security@aurorafinancial.com>, Aaron Holt <aaron.holt@aurorafinancial.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: backup chain-of-custody & restore latency proof for SIG/BCP

Ben / Marissa — assigning this to ops + compliance. Aurora wants the backup manifest, signature chain, and example restore traces for the last 6 months and a witness run Nov 1–5.

Ben, can you assemble the artifacts listed below and include an estimate of expected RTO for both full DB (cold restore) and warm-cache (KV) restore from most recent snapshots? Marissa, please add the runbook snippets and owner roster and coordinate the witness session times.

Aurora: we can provide an initial artifact packet by Oct 31 and we have a couple of windows for a live restore demo: Nov 2 (14:00–16:00 PDT) or Nov 4 (09:00–11:00 PDT). Which works best for you?

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Reliability Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Park <security@aurorafinancial.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: backup chain-of-custody & restore latency proof for SIG/BCP

Hannah / Marissa / Lauren — attaching the initial artifacts. See the stubs below (full files in link to follow):

Attached: redwood_backup_manifest_202610.tar.gz (manifest csv, rotation actor, storage path timestamps)
Attached: backup-signature-chain-202610.txt (SHA256 signatures + signer IDs, key IDs redacted)
Attached: full-db-restore-timeline-202610.pdf (extracted metrics from restore rehearsals; includes start/finish, bytes transferred, and dominant waiting phases)
Attached: kv-restore-trace-202610.csv (KV warm cache restore traces; per-region timings)

Quick summary of observed median RTOs from rehearsals (internal test cluster, representative dataset):
- Full DB cold restore (from S3-equivalent cold tier): median 3h 42m; 95th pctile 4h 15m.
- Warm-cache (KV) restore + readiness (cache primed + traffic warmup): median 12m; 95th pctile 22m.

Notes: the full DB restore time depends heavily on snapshot size and network throughput; we include a calibration table in the PDF that maps snapshot sizes to expected restore durations. The KV restore CSV includes timestamps for KV segments and the KV validation checks we run post-restore.

Ben Carter
Senior Site Reliability Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Park <security@aurorafinancial.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 00:22:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: backup chain-of-custody & restore latency proof for SIG/BCP

Ben — thanks for the packet, that helps a lot. A couple of quick clarifications before we schedule the witness run: 

1) For the signature chain: can you provide the public key IDs and a short explanation of your signing process (who has signing rights, rotation cadence, and where audit logs live)? The signature file you sent has signatures but we need mapping to key IDs for our vendor assessment.

2) For the warm-cache RTO: can you separate out the KV load-priming step vs. the validation step in the CSV? We need distinct timings so our ops team can independently model warm-up behavior.

3) For the witness run: Nov 2 (15:00–16:00 PDT) would work for our team — we'd like to witness a cold snapshot restore to the point where we can run a smoke traffic test, and then observe the KV warm-cache replay. Total window 60–75 minutes. Please confirm and provide a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Lauren

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lauren Park <security@aurorafinancial.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: backup chain-of-custody & restore latency proof for SIG/BCP

Lauren — confirming Nov 2 15:00–16:15 PDT for the witness run (we'll plan 75 minutes to be safe).

Action items we will deliver before the session (by EOD Nov 1 PST):
- Backup-signature-chain-202610.txt (now with key IDs and a short appendix explaining rotation cadence and signer roles).
- kv-restore-trace-202610-v2.csv (separates priming vs validation timings; Ben will add column descriptions).
- A short runbook excerpt with the owner roster and escalation phone list (Marissa to populate).
- Shared Drive link with full artifacts and a one-page readme for Aurora.

Ben / Marissa — please drop the updated files into the Drive folder and send the calendar invite to Lauren + Aaron; include dial-in and a non-prod test account for the smoke traffic.

Hannah Schmitt
Head of Reliability Compliance (acting)
Redwood Inference
